zh: 听音乐：通过耳朵感受和欣赏音乐的活动。
en: to use your ears to hear music
ex: I usually listen to music on my own.

zh: 进行体育运动：参与各种体育运动，如足球、篮球、网球等。
en: to take part in games or activities such as football or swimming that need physical activity and skill

zh: 制造机器人：使用各种材料和技术来设计、制造和组装机器人。
en: to make machines controlled by computers, which can move and do other things that people can do

zh: to use the internet to talk to friends
en: to use the internet to talk to friends
ex: I always chat to friends online after school.

en: to move your feet and body to the rhythm of music
ex: I often dance in the living room.

zh: 做作业，做家庭作业；做足功课（事先认真研究某个主题或情况，以便能够妥善处理）。
en: to do work your teacher has given you to do at home
ex: I never do homework in the morning.

zh: 购物：去商店或商场浏览和购买商品（说明购买对象时常用 go shopping for something）。
en: to visit shops in order to buy things
ex: She sometimes goes shopping with her mum.

zh: 与朋友一起闲逛：与朋友一起放松、聚会或共度时光。
ex: We often hang out with friends in the park.

zh: 玩电脑游戏：使用电脑进行游戏活动。
en: to play games designed to be used on a computer
ex: I never play computer games in the morning.

en: a small electronic device which allows you to read books on a screen
ex: I use my e-reader to read books.

en: a piece of equipment for playing computer games
ex: I use my games console to play computer games.

zh: abbreviation for Global Positioning System: a system that can show the position of a person or thing by using signals from satellites
en: abbreviation for Global Positioning System: a system that can show the position of a person or thing by using signals from satellites
ex: I use my GPS to find out which way to go.

zh: 耳机，头戴式耳机，头戴式受话器（headphone 的复数形式）；（旧式电话等）听筒，受话器
en: a ​device with a ​part to ​cover each ​ear through which you can ​listen to ​music
ex: I use my headphones to listen to music.

zh: 膝上型计算机，便携式电脑（=laptop computer）
en: a computer that is small enough to be carried around and used where you are sitting
ex: I use my laptop to do homework.

zh: 智能手机（运行移动操作系统，可安装并运行应用程序，具备较强计算和联网能力的移动电话）
en: a mobile phone that can be used as a small computer and that connects to the internet
ex: I use my smartphone to talk to my friends.

zh: a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen
en: a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen
ex: I use my tablet to shop.

zh: 虚拟现实头戴式显示器（VR 头显、VR 头盔）
en: equipment that you wear over your eyes and ears to experience images and sounds produced by a computer as if they were part of real life (VR = virtual reality)
ex: I use my VR headset to play computer  games.
